name: ship-sentinel
description: Holds ship commands (git push, gh pr create, npm publish, deploys) until your pre-ship check skills have run since the last edit.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: ask: hold a ship command and ask whether to run the checks first. block: refuse until the checks have run. nudge: let it run and remind Claude afterwards. off: do nothing.

required.title: Required check skills
required.description: Comma-separated names of the skills that count as pre-ship checks. All of them must have run since the last edit.
